entities.name: Sebastian Vettel
entities.description: A German former racing driver who competed in Formula One from 2007 to 2022. He won four Formula One World Drivers' Championship titles consecutively from 2010 to 2013 with Red Bull and remains the youngest-ever World Drivers' Champion. He won 53 Grands Prix across 16 seasons.
